verdict.rationale: Snyk Code's marketing says users can write their own queries using DeepCode AI logic with autocomplete. There are no docs on the query syntax or on sharing those queries across repositories. Separately, Snyk IaC custom rules are written in Rego via an SDK that supports writing, testing, bundling and pushing rule bundles to OCI registries for distribution, but that covers IaC configuration rather than application-code SAST, and Rego is not an especially simple syntax. Missing for 10: documented custom SAST rule syntax for Snyk Code, a mechanism for sharing custom code rules across repos or orgs, and independent hands-on corroboration.
